plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for HPE MSM / Colubris wireless controller and AP platform. It reports uptime, CPU utilization (now and 5-second), 1-minute load average, memory total/free/usage and temporary storage usage, based on the COLUBRIS-USAGE-INFORMATION-MIB (coUsageInformationGroup, enterprise PEN 8744). There is no chassis temperature, fan or PSU gauge.
name: Wireless

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: Current CPU utilization of the HPE MSM / Colubris device (coUsInfoCpuUseNow), as a 0-100 percentage. Values outside 0..100 and the 4294967295 sentinel are dropped.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage_5s
metrics.description: 5-second CPU utilization of the HPE MSM / Colubris device (coUsInfoCpuUse5Sec), as a 0-100 percentage. Values outside 0..100 and sentinels are dropped.

metrics.name: device_load_average
metrics.description: 1-minute load average of the HPE MSM / Colubris device (coUsInfoLoadAverage1Min). Negative values and sentinels are dropped.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total RAM of the HPE MSM / Colubris device in bytes (coUsInfoRamTotal, reported in Kb and multiplied by 1024 at collection time). Total 0 or 4294967295 drops all memory metrics.

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Free RAM of the HPE MSM / Colubris device in bytes (coUsInfoRamFree, reported in Kb and multiplied by 1024 at collection time). Raw Kb helper fields are not stored.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilization of the HPE MSM / Colubris device as (total-free)/total×100, rounded to 0.1. Computed only when total > 0 and free ≤ total. Conversion is done once in the collector, not in the query.

metrics.name: device_storage_usage
metrics.description: Temporary storage utilization of the HPE MSM / Colubris device (coUsInfoStorageUseTemporary), as a 0-100 percentage. Values outside 0..100 are dropped.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
